sloka: कन्या हि द्वे कुले नित्यं संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति ।पुत्रद्वयं ममाप्यस्यां भार्यायां सम्बभूव ह ।। ७.१२.१२ ॥
transliteration: kanyā hi dve kule nityaṁ saṁśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati ।putradvayaṁ mamāpyasyāṁ bhāryāyāṁ sambabhūva ha ।। 7.12.12 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a daughter always keeps two families in a state of uncertainty; also, two sons were born to me from this wife.
